label: Tier 1: rule decks and parameters
subgoals: Check whether the engine already reads the value to change
Change the value without touching code
Rerun reference layouts to confirm only intended results moved

label: Tier 2: plug-ins at a seam
subgoals: Find the seam whose interface carries the needed context
Implement the new behaviour behind that seam
Show with a differential run that only intended results changed

label: Tier 3: touching the kernel
subgoals: Recognize a change to representation or exact computation
Route it through review with full regression
Add a seam when the same kind of core change recurs
